# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_routing (Resource)

The connection that receives inbound WhatsApp calls to a WhatsApp Calling BYON (bring your own number) phone number. Creating this resource adopts the routing of an existing number; destroying it leaves the routing as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deliver inbound WhatsApp calls to a bring-your-own number to a Call Control
# application. Destroy leaves the routing as it is.
resource "telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_routing" "support" {
  phone_number  = "+13125550123"
  connection_id = telnyx_call_control_application.ivr.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) ID of the connection that inbound WhatsApp calls to the number are delivered to.
- `phone_number` (String) The BYON phone number in E.164 format, with the leading `+`.

### Read-Only

- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_calling_routing.support <phone_number>
```
